d:
Bihar ke saharsa jile se ek bari khabar samne aa rahi hai, jahan pulis hirasat men lie gae premi-premika men se premi ne saurbajar thana ke shauchalay men phansi lagakar aatmahatya kar li. is ghatna ki khabar milte hi pulis mahakme men khalabli mach gaee, vahin mritak ke parivar men kohram mach gaya hai. mritak ki pahchan saurbajar thana kshetr ke kachra ganv nivasi anmol sharma ke rup men huee hai.
Kort men peshi se pahle thana ke shauchalay men kapre ke phande se lagaee phansi?
